name: NHS — ADHD in children and young people
description: NHS public information on ADHD in children and young people, school and GP support, referral for assessment, waiting and the specialist assessment process.
intended_use: Use as the national England-facing starting route when a child or young person may need ADHD support or assessment.
audience_or_context: Children and young people, parents/carers and supporters in England using NHS public information.
limitations: The page is general national information; local referral routes, service criteria and waits vary.
School support and clinical diagnosis are distinct processes.
Right to Choose described on the page is an England NHS route and must not be exported to other UK nations.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible online; NHS assessment access depends on current eligibility and local service arrangements.
conflicts_of_interest: The NHS publishes information about NHS pathways it operates; ND Oracle records the official route without assuming local availability or individual outcome.

provenance.method: Current NHS child/young-person ADHD page checked on 2026-09-03 for school/GP support, referral, waiting, specialist assessment and England Right to Choose wording. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
